o.norm: Consonants from the same code group separated by W or H are treated as one. Test data from http://www.myatt.demon.co.uk/sxalg.htm

i.norm:
Verifies Soundex's "H/W rule": consonants belonging to the same code group that are separated only by an H or a W are collapsed into a single code digit.

Both spellings of "Booth Davis" below encode to {@code "B312"} because the silent H (in "BOOTH") is ignored and the separator hyphen is stripped before encoding.
